assignments.package_label_en: Melody and the Song of the Land
assignments.reason: The niggun is the dominant node of Package 1. Its essential nature is the holy melody — the cosmic song that flows from the Land of Israel through the herbs to the shepherd. It appears as the cause side of three eitza edges, producing sustenance (מזון), clarification of human spirit from animal spirit (נתברר רוח האדם מרוח הבהמה), and salvation from animality (נצול מרוח הבהמיות). The node is already identified as the heart of Package 1 in the additions file. It is bechina of התברורות הרוח, זמרת הארץ, שירת העשבים, and פרק שירה.

connected_to: נותן כח בעשבים, ויש מרעה לבהמות
assignments.package_label_en: Melody and the Song of the Land
assignments.reason: The 'zemer and niggun that the shepherd knows' is essentially the niggun itself as wielded by the shepherd. Its essential nature is identical to the melody domain — it is the same cosmic song (zimrat ha-aretz) applied by the shepherd to his specific location and herbs. The source text (line 4-5) explicitly identifies the shepherd's knowledge of the niggun as the mechanism: 'וְעַל־יְדֵי שֶׁהָרוֹעֶה יוֹדֵעַ הַנִּגּוּן, עַל־יְדֵי־זֶה הוּא נוֹתֵן כֹּחַ בְּהָעֲשָׂבִים'. This is a specific expression of the niggun, not a separate concept. It belongs in Package 1 alongside ניגון and זמרת הארץ, which share the same essential nature as holy melody.

This node describes the clarification/separation of the human spirit from the animal spirit. Its essential nature is the human spirit achieving its proper state — ascending upward, separating from the downward pull of animality. The source text (line 7): 'כִּי נִתְבָּרֵר רוּחַ הָאָדָם מֵרוּחַ הַבְּהֵמָה עַל־יְדֵי הַנִּגּוּן'. While the niggun (Package 1) causes this clarification, the concept itself IS about the human spirit achieving its proper orientation. It describes a state-change belonging to the domain of ruach ha-adam — the ascending human spirit. It belongs in Package 2 alongside רוח האדם, whose essential nature it shares.

Salvation from the animal spirit (נצול מרוח הבהמיות) is essentially about the animal spirit domain — it describes what happens TO ruach ha-behema (the shepherd is saved FROM it). Its essential nature is the evil force being overcome, parallel to how הכנעת היצר הרע belongs to the evil package in Torah #1. The source text (line 6-7): 'הָיָה אֶפְשָׁר שֶׁיַּמְשִׁיכוּ וְיוֹרִידוּ אֶת הָרוֹעֶה מִבְּחִינַת רוּחַ הָאָדָם לְרוּחַ הַבַּהֲמִיּוּת... וְעַל־יְדֵי הַנִּגּוּן נִצּוֹל מִזֶּה'. While the niggun (Package 1) causes the salvation, the concept itself is defined by what it acts upon: the animal spirit. It belongs in Package 3 alongside רוח הבהמה.

Sustenance (מזון) is the physical outcome produced by the niggun through the king. The source text (line 9): 'כִּי נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר שֶׁהָיָה מֶלֶךְ וְיֵשׁ לוֹ כָּל הַנִּגּוּן, עַל כֵּן עַל־יָדוֹ נִמְשָׁךְ כָּל הַמָּזוֹן, כִּי הַמָּזוֹן נִמְשָׁךְ עַל־יְדֵי הַנִּגּוּן'. Sustenance is a neutral physical outcome — it is not inherently holy or evil but is a concrete material result. It belongs in Package 4 alongside מנחה and משקולות הניגון, which represent the concrete, material-structural dimension of the melody. The gift items (tzori, honey, nuts, almonds) that are bechina of the niggun's measures are themselves physical sustenance-products of the land, and מזון is the ultimate physical expression of what the niggun's concrete dimension produces.

assignments.node_id: נותן כח בעשבים, ויש מרעה לבהמות
assignments.node_text: נוֹתֵן כֹּחַ בָּעֲשָׂבִים, וְיֵשׁ מִרְעֶה לַבְּהֵמוֹת
assignments.reason: Giving strength to the herbs and providing pasture for animals is the concrete, physical effect of the shepherd's melody. Its essential nature is the material sustenance dimension — the tangible outcome in the physical world. The source text (line 4-5): 'עַל־יְדֵי שֶׁהָרוֹעֶה יוֹדֵעַ הַנִּגּוּן, עַל־יְדֵי־זֶה הוּא נוֹתֵן כֹּחַ בְּהָעֲשָׂבִים, וַאֲזַי יֵשׁ לַבְּהֵמוֹת לֶאֱכֹל'. Like מזון, this is a neutral physical outcome — herbs growing and animals having pasture are natural phenomena that serve as the concrete material dimension of the melody's operation. It belongs in Package 4 alongside מזון and משקולות הניגון, sharing the essential nature of the melody's tangible, structural-material expression.

alias_notes.reason: The 'zemer and niggun that the shepherd knows' (זמר והנגון שהרועה יודע) is a longer descriptive form of ניגון as applied by the shepherd. The source text treats them as the same concept: 'נִמְצָא שֶׁעַל־יְדֵי הַזֶּמֶר וְהַנִּגּוּן שֶׁהָרוֹעֶה יוֹדֵעַ, הוּא נוֹתֵן כֹּחַ בָּעֲשָׂבִים'. This is the niggun specified to the shepherd's context. It could be treated as an alias of ניגון rather than a separate node.
